scenes.text: What if time stopped - but only for you?
Everyone would freeze mid-step. The world would hold its breath.
You could walk anywhere. Move anything.
But light is carried by time. Without it, you would see nothing at all.
You would be awake, alone, in perfect darkness, forever.
Follow What If Physics for more.
